name: Calendar
description: Low-level calendar primitive built on react-day-picker. Use Calendar directly when you need full control: custom day modifiers (booked/highlighted/disabled dates with custom styles), multiple date selection, an embedded calendar without a popover trigger, or a bespoke booking UI. For standard date and range selection in forms and filters, prefer DatePicker, DateRangePicker, or DateTimePicker — they wrap Calendar with a trigger button, popover management, Apply/Clear patterns, and a consistent UX out of the box.

props.name: localeCode
props.description: The locale code for date formatting and month/weekday names. Maps to date-fns locale objects.

props.name: buttonVariant
props.description: The Button variant used for the previous/next navigation arrows.

props.name: captionLayout
props.description: How the month/year caption is displayed. 'label' shows static text, 'dropdown' shows selectable month and year dropdowns.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Whether to show days from the previous and next months in the calendar grid.

props.name: mode
props.description: The selection mode. Inherited from react-day-picker DayPicker.

props.name: selected
props.description: The currently selected date(s). Controlled prop.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Callback fired when a date is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Days that should be disabled and unselectable.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the calendar root.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Override class names for individual calendar parts (root, months, day, etc.).

props.name: formatters
props.description: Custom formatter functions. The default formatMonthDropdown respects the localeCode.

props.name: components
props.description: Override internal components (Root, Chevron, DayButton, WeekNumber). The default DayButton is CalendarDayButton with range-aware data attributes.

accessibility.role: The calendar uses a table-based layout with appropriate table, thead, tbody, tr, td semantics provided by react-day-picker.
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate between days. Home/End move to start/end of the week. PageUp/PageDown move between months. Enter/Space select a day. Focus management is handled automatically by CalendarDayButton.
accessibility.aria: Day buttons include aria-disabled for disabled days. Selected days are indicated via data-selected attributes. Outside days use aria-selected for range selections.
accessibility.notes: The CalendarDayButton sub-component uses data attributes (data-selected-single, data-range-start, data-range-end, data-range-middle) for styling different selection states. A focus effect is triggered via React.useEffect when modifiers.focused is true.

recommendations.description: Use DatePicker for single date selection in forms and filters — it wraps Calendar with a trigger button, popover, and date formatting.
Use DateRangePicker for date range selection in DataTableToolbar and filter panels — it replaces the manual Calendar+Popover+Button pattern.
Use DateTimePicker when the user must select both a date and a time in a single interaction.
Use Calendar directly when you need the modifiers system: custom styles for booked, highlighted, or disabled dates (e.g. booking interfaces, availability pickers).
Use Calendar directly for multiple date selection (mode='multiple') or when you want the calendar inline (not inside a popover).
Format selected dates with date-fns format() when displaying values outside the calendar.
Don't use Calendar + Popover + Button manually to build a basic date picker — use DatePicker or DateRangePicker instead.
Don't use Calendar inside DataTableToolbar for date range filters — use DateRangePicker which handles the Popover, trigger button, and Apply/Clear logic.
Don't format dates with toLocaleDateString() — use date-fns format() for consistent locale-aware output.
